name: AURIC
title: The Last Crown
story: When darkness swallowed his kingdom, everyone fled. He stayed. He wears his crown as a promise to find his people a new sun.

name: VOLT
title: Spark of Rebellion
story: They cut the city’s power, believing it would silence the uprising. Volt caught a lightning bolt. Now, every step he takes lights up the forbidden streets.

name: NYX
title: The Forgotten Shadow
story: The only witness to the sun thief’s face. To survive, he surrendered his name to the darkness. Now he hunts an enemy no one remembers.

name: GALE
title: The Final Flight
story: The last pilot to take off before the skies were sealed. He still hears his missing squadron’s call—and saves no fuel for the journey home.

name: KNOX
title: Heir to the Streets
story: When the palace gates closed, he built a city for its abandoned children. His golden chain was forged from the shattered throne of the first tyrant he overthrew.

name: PYRE
title: The Last Ember
story: He reached for the final spark that fell from the stolen sun. As long as his fire burns, the world still has a chance to be reborn.

name: ORBIT
title: Beyond the Void
story: He followed the stolen sun’s trail beyond the stars. Years later, he returned with an impossible reflection in his visor: a dawn that had yet to exist.

name: RONIN
title: The Unbroken Oath
story: He sealed his blade the night he failed to protect his master. He will draw it only when he stands before the true ruler behind the darkness.

name: BLACKTIDE
title: The Midnight Sea
story: He traded an eye to learn where the light lay beyond the horizon. His ship’s compass points toward the stolen sun.

name: ECHO
title: Dawn Frequency
story: He recorded the final sound before the sun vanished. If he finds the right rhythm, the entire city will play as one—and unlock the sky.
